items.title: Buddy Tate interviewed by Michael Woods, Scottsdale, Arizona, March 3, 1995
items.q: The interviewee discusses Billie Holiday and Nat King Cole in response to the interviewer's mention of Sarah Vaughan, but provides no personal interaction or specific relationship details regarding Sarah Vaughan herself.

ctx.x: Sarah Vaughan, I met them all, and I loved Billie Holiday. I loved Billie. She was, I just loved Billie she was special, very special.

Yes she had ... her choice of songs were different. She would sing like “Good Morning Heartache,” and she’d pick the right songs, and just for her. I guess it was because she’d lived a, you know, a sad life. And “Good Morning Heartache,” “Fine and Mellow,” and what was the next one she sang she used to do, I can’t even remember, but I dug her choice. Nat King Cole was another one, picked the right songs to sing.
